models.name: Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B
models.weight_gb: UD-IQ1_S (1-bit GGUF, ~3.5GB smaller than NVIDIA's official 2-bit)

engines.hardware: RTX 3060 12GB + 16GB system RAM (57 MoE layers' experts on CPU)
engines.quant: Unsloth UD-IQ1_S 1-bit GGUF, Flash Attention, Q8_0 KV cache; --n-cpu-moe 57 -ngl 99 --load-mode none

models.why: A 74B MoE on a 12 GB RTX 3060: Unsloth's 1-bit UD-IQ1_S GGUF (~3.5GB smaller than NVIDIA's official 2-bit at the same perplexity), 57 MoE layers' experts on the CPU, ~30 tok/s decode and ~800 tok/s prefill over a 262K context.

models.name: Nemotron-Labs Dory 4B

engines.quant: Q5_K_M weights, Q8 KV cache; entire workload (weights, KV cache, embeddings) on the GPU
engines.engine_min_version: llama.cpp change llama.cpp#30306 (not yet upstream), llama-server -np 1 -fa with 262,144 ctx and dory.recurrent_kv_cache_mode=last_loop

models.why: A 4B looped-architecture model holding a 256K context on a single 12 GB RTX 3060 at ~50 tok/s (~1,580 tok/s prefill) by keeping the KV cache at one loop's size and placing scale/alpha tensors plus embeddings on CUDA (+32% decode).
